summary: STANDARDS AS CLAIMED BY THE VENDOR'S DATASHEET, NOT VERIFIED HERE. ST DS12484 Rev 8 (May 2023, sha256 of datasheet.pdf in this row) states verbatim: 'NFC-A / ISO14443A up to 848 kbit/s', 'NFC-B / ISO14443B up to 848 kbit/s', 'NFC-V / ISO15693 up to 53 kb/s', 'EMVCo 3.0 analog and digital compliant', 'ISO 18092 passive and active initiator', and under Applications 'ISO14443 and ISO15693 compliant general purpose NFC device' and 'EMVCo 3.0 compliant contactless payment terminal'. These are the protocol standards the chip implements (ISO/IEC 14443, ISO/IEC 15693, ISO/IEC 18092, EMVCo 3.0). WHAT THIS ROW IS NOT: not a dimensional catalogue standard, not a conformance test run here, and there is no sourced offer in this folder — so T4 is neither earned nor claimed (TRIAD.md). Whether the Microduck fits this chip at all is CANNOT DETERMINE.

summary: PACKAGE OUTLINES RE-SOURCED FROM THE MECHANICAL DRAWINGS THAT WERE ALREADY IN THIS FOLDER. The 2026-09-02 package_outline row cited the ST PRODUCT PAGE package list and said the land pattern needed 'the mechanical drawing in the ST25R3916 datasheet's package-information section'. That section was already here: DS12484 Rev 8 section 6, pages 150-155 of 160 of the datasheet.pdf this folder's PROVENANCE.json already hashed (sha256 1170f4d7..., re-fetched from st.com 2026-09-03 and byte-identical). All three shipped packages now carry their own min/typ/max: UFQFPN32 (Table 135 p.153) A 0.500/0.550/0.600, A1 0.000/0.020/0.050, A3 0.152 typ, b 0.180-0.300, D and E 4.900/5.000/5.100, D1/E1 and D2/E2 3.400/3.500/3.600, e 0.500, L 0.300/0.400/0.500, ddd 0.080 MAX, footprint example Figure 39 land span 5.30 with a 3.80 pad; VFQFPN32 NRND (Table 134 pp.150-151) A 0.800/0.900/1.000, D=E 5.000 typ, D2=E2 3.400/3.500/3.600, e 0.500, S1 0.350; WLCSP36 (Table 136 p.155) A 0.550/0.590/0.630, D 3.193/3.213/3.233, E 3.183/3.203/3.223, ball b 0.330, e 0.500, e1 2.500. NO DIMENSION IS CONTRADICTED - the product page's 5x5x0.55 is the drawing's TYP - but the drawing's note 2 that D and E EXCLUDE up to 0.1500 mm of mould protrusion is recorded for the first time, so the envelope an enclosure must clear is 5.2500 mm and not 5.1000. STILL CANNOT DETERMINE: which of the three packages the Microduck actually uses, because the board that carries it is unpublished; what settles it is a photograph of that board or a BOM line, since a 5 mm square QFN and a 3.2 mm CSP are told apart by eye.
